title: Events alert — 2026-11-03
body:
Just landed: Fabrinet +9–11% after hours on Q1 revenue $1.47B (+51%) and a Q2 guide of $1.60–1.65B vs ~$1.48B consensus — but FCF −$137M. Williams in line, flat. Read-across positive for Coherent/Lumentum into tonight.

Today: US midterms all day (results overnight into Wednesday Berlin). Pre-market 12:30 Berlin / 06:30 ET — Eaton (consensus ~$3.54 EPS; datacenter orders the tell) and Talen. After close 22:15 Berlin / 16:15 ET — AMD (~$1.95 EPS, ~$13.1B revenue) plus SMCI, Arista, Astera; the semis' binary test.

Tomorrow, Wed Nov 4, 22:15 Berlin / 16:15 ET: Arm and Coherent.

Sleeves: power needs Eaton to confirm after Vertiv's +16.5%; semis carry this week's binary; keep the 15% cash sleeve parked. Correction: Nvidia is confirmed for Tue Nov 17 (company release), not Nov 25.

Sources: web search 2026-11-03 (GlobeNewswire/Barron's via Yahoo, Investing.com, NVIDIA IR).
